'''Domi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galacian]] and a member of the [[Hill people]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]]. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], Domi was part of the defense organized by [[Elan Tallah|Elan]], leader of the Hill people, to engage the [[proton tank]]s of the [[Royal guard (Gala)|royal guards]] when they [[Battle of Gala|attacked]] the Hill people's encampment. Domi suffered a minor injury when he grazed his head on a branch during the battle. Afterwards, his injury was treated by Elan herself in her own [[Elan's dome|dome]]. There, he met the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and proceed to tell him stories of Elan's parents.<ref name="MotC" />
